_about: Reviewer support for the Grade 4 Math founder review. Prepared 2026-09-26 by LiberiaLearn curriculum tooling (AI-assisted); updated the same day to apply the curriculum/product review CPR-2026-09-26 (decisions in reviewer-recommendations.json). This file records NO review decision: decisions live only in review-ledger.json and are made by a human. MOE source text is never normalized in place; every reading below cites the structured MOE items it rests on (curriculum/structured/moe-structured-v1.json).

method.answers: Every practice, homework, quiz, diagnostic and exit-assessment answer in the 43 drafts and the 2026.2 fractions candidate was recomputed by hand on 2026-09-26, and again after the CPR-2026-09-26 revisions; __tests__/curriculum/g4-math-answer-keys.test.ts recomputes the plain-calculation items (whole-number and fraction arithmetic, rounding, LCM/GCF, simplifying, mode/median/mean) on every CI run; word problems and conceptual items are hand-checked. No wrong answer key was found.

classifications.SOURCE_RESOLVED: The structured MOE source (same page, same topic table, or an adjacent grade) settles the question. Any change proposed is supported by that evidence.
classifications.LIBERIALEARN_CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED: The source cannot settle it; LiberiaLearn must state its reading or convention explicitly in the lesson, keeping the MOE text verbatim.
classifications.HUMAN_POLICY_DECISION_REQUIRED: A product or curriculum policy choice that belongs to the founder, not a question of source reading.

method.appliedDecision: A disposition with appliedDecision was settled by the named decision of the curriculum/product review CPR-2026-09-26 (reviewer-recommendations.json), and the change is applied in the lesson or cell. That review is not founder approval and not MOE approval; it records no ledger decision.

defaults.answers: VERIFIED: all answer keys recomputed; no errors.

wording.moeDerived: The objective statement (verbatim MOE text).
wording.liberiaLearnExplanatory: Title, explanation, worked examples, activities, all practice, homework, quiz, diagnostic and assessment items, teacher notes.

defaults.gradeAppropriate: Appropriate for Grade 4 and within the MOE scope for this objective.
defaults.alignment: Classwork, practice, homework, quiz and exit assessment all target this objective; the diagnostic checks a prerequisite.

moe-math-g4-s1-p1-numeration-addition-an.resolution: The operation and data context are corroborated on the same page: act3 'Add two or more (births and deaths) from the pollution data', act4 'Subtract two or more components of (births and deaths) from the population data', out1 'Use population data of births and death to add and subtract whole numbers'. Text past the parsed boundary could not change the operation. ('pollution' in act3 is itself a source typo; act4 and out1 say population.) MOE text kept verbatim.

The tail-boundary part is source-resolved (see #confidence). What remains is data policy: MOE materials name a 'Life skills POPFLE Resource book' and a 'Poster sheet showing population data', i.e. MOE expects real population figures. The draft uses invented figures, labeled as example data. MOE activities mention births and deaths only; the lesson's migration items follow the objective text, which names migration.
moe-math-g4-s1-p1-numeration-addition-an.decisionNeeded: Keep labeled invented figures, or source real figures (POPFLE resource or national census) with a citation.

evidence: Grade 5 OBJECTIVE p50 'Write factor for parts of a set.'

Fractions greater than one are an optional extension. The 2026.1 lesson is unchanged. Pending founder review.

The draft's sentence 'The MOE activity uses counters...' overstates the source: MOE names base-10 counters; the 3/10 + 4/10 example is LiberiaLearn's.

'pentago n' is a text-extraction spacing artifact inside one word; the list (triangles, quadrilaterals, ___, hexagon) and act3 'Sort out polygons according to sides and identify each' admit only 'pentagon'. Raw text kept verbatim.
The topic's content column lists 'Solid figures' (con5, p48); page 49 is the topic's second page.
Solids need spatial inspection of hidden faces, and no 3D runtime exists. Real physical solids are the required modality; a 3D solids viewer is a planned enhancement.

moe-math-g4-s2-p6-geometry-and-statistic.resolution: The topic's content column includes 'Reading and interpreting figures from charts and graphs such as Bar graphs, line graphs, pie chart' (con5, p48).

The source expects more than the words: out2 'Use population data to read and interpret bar graph, line graph, pie chart, and mean, mode, medium and average', and act6 'Collect data about family size and display the data on a bar graph, line graph, and pie chart.' The draft uses a fruit survey and does not assess reading a measure from a graph.
moe-math-g4-s2-p6-geometry-and-statistic.proposedCorrection: Make the class survey a voluntary, anonymous family-size survey (act6) and add: practice 'In the family-size bar graph, which family size has the tallest bar? That value is the mode.' and a quiz item reading the mode from a bar graph. Calculation of mean and median stays in 6.7.

moe-math-g4-s2-p6-geometry-and-statistic.resolution: LOW confidence comes from an ambiguous column (objective vs activity). The instructional target is corroborated (out2 p48 lists mean, mode, median/'medium'; act6 p49 family-size data; Grade 3 p37 'Find the mean, mode and median of the data'), so the lesson content stands either way. The column itself can only be confirmed by a person reading page 49 of Math 1-6.pdf.
evidence: Grade 3 OBJECTIVE p37 'Find the mean, mode and median of the data.'

moe-math-g4-s2-p6-geometry-and-statistic.resolution: The same MOE document spells 'median' correctly in Grade 4 objective 6 (p49) and Grade 3 (p37). 'Medium' recurs only as a consistent misspelling (Grade 3 act p36, Grade 4 out2 p48, this objective) and is not a statistical measure. The lesson says 'median'; the MOE text is preserved verbatim in the objective record and review package. The lesson's family-size data follows act6; figures are invented and labeled. The lesson's teacher notes state the interpretation and that the source text itself is not corrected.
evidence: Grade 3 OBJECTIVE p37 'Find the mean, mode and median of the data.'
